Ukraine advances EU accession bid by passing minority rights law

Ukraine's bid for European Union membership has advanced after lawmakers passed legislation protecting the rights of national minorities. This action removes a significant hurdle and addresses concerns that had led Hungary to previously veto Ukraine's accession process. The new law is seen as a key step in Kyiv's efforts to join the EU.
